sourceTitle: The Happiness of Heaven By a Father of the Society of Jesus
description: "The Happiness of Heaven" by F. J. Boudreaux is a theological treatise written in the late 19th century. The text explores profound concepts surrounding the nature and experience of heaven, particularly focusing on the Beatific Vision—the direct experience of God that constitutes the essence of happiness in the afterlife.
